title: Histoire de poissons
brief_description: A third language training film relating adventures of the Martin family. The family is on holiday in France and M. Martin is out fishing - Monsieur le Cure is coming for dinner and, being Friday, fish is essential. The foibles of promising a fish dinner are developed, wherein each member of the family purchases a fish to make sure there will be plenty for the dinner guest.
